label: TP-Link Archer VR600 AC1600 wireless gigabit VDSL/ADSL modem router
description: AC1600 dual-band VDSL2 (profile 17a, 100 Mbit/s) and ADSL2+ modem router with 300 Mbit/s on 2.4 GHz, 1300 Mbit/s on 5 GHz, one RJ-11 DSL port, three gigabit LAN ports plus a fourth gigabit LAN/WAN port for EWAN, and a USB port.
notes: TP-Link spec table: 'Interface: 3 Gigabit LAN Ports, 1 Gigabit LAN/WAN Port, 1 RJ11 Port, 1 USB Port'; VDSL2 'Up to 17a profile (POTS)'; Wi-Fi 300 Mbps (2.4 GHz) + 1300 Mbps (5 GHz). Lan4 is the LAN/WAN combo port, declared as a fourth LAN port. The DSL line is 17a-class 100 Mbit/s, not gigabit.
